description.value: Minoru Arenas is a two-storey, municipally operated ice facility on Minoru Gate in Richmond, BC, hosting public skating and ice hockey year-round. Operated by the City of Richmond, it sits within the Minoru Park recreation precinct alongside several other civic recreation centres. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond may find it useful as a landmark or rest stop, though it is primarily a local recreational facility.
